issue.title: Pause downloads when Wi-Fi drops and cellular is off [Going offline Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the going offline audit (#529, epic #526), scenario E.19 re-tested on PR #559.

**Severity:** High  
**Launch blocker:** To be decided with product  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local debug build of `ddfdaaa` (PR #559 head), `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenario E.19)

## Summary

The Wi-Fi / cellular gate (#546, PR #559) applies only when the user taps Download or Resume and to auto-resume at start. Once the queue is running, the worker never checks transport again: `processNext` (`src/services/downloadQueueWorker.ts:199-272`) starts the next item right after the previous one finishes or fails. When Wi-Fi drops, the item in flight fails and, as soon as mobile data comes up, the queue keeps downloading over cellular with the toggle off. Items interrupted by the drop are marked `failed` in a cascade, and progress is lost for items without resume data.

## Expected

"When off, uploads and downloads only initiate or continue over WiFi; if WiFi is lost while either is active, pause automatically" (#146).

## Actual

Project 479, 13 items, toggle off, Wi-Fi and mobile data on. Wi-Fi turned off at 14:08:48: item 2 (audio, 5%) failed with "Software caused connection abort", item 3 failed on DNS, then item 4 started over mobile data and reached 94% (~8.4 MB) before a manual Pause. Pause and Cancel stayed visible the whole time. A second path hits the same gap: auto-resume starts the queue on Wi-Fi at login, and it keeps running after the device moves to cellular.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Toggle "Upload/Download over cellular" off; Wi-Fi and mobile data on.
2. Prepare for Offline → Download a chapter not yet downloaded.
3. While it downloads, turn Wi-Fi off.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] When transport no longer allows transfer (Wi-Fi lost with the toggle off, or no link), the active download pauses and keeps its resume data.
- [ ] The worker checks transport before starting each queued item.
- [ ] A transport loss does not mark items `failed`; they stay paused or queued.
- [ ] The queue resumes on its own when Wi-Fi returns (existing auto-resume).
- [ ] Unit test: transport change to blocked during a download → paused, no next item started.
- [ ] Android device QA (E.19).

## Related

- Parent audit: #529 (epic #526)
- #146 (spec), #546 / PR #559 (start and resume gate), #572 (closed without a fix), #604 (same behavior on the upload side)
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/going-offline/README.md` (PR #577)
